newsitem.title: UK: Manganese Bronze marked up after AGM.
newsitem.headline: Manganese Bronze marked up after AGM.

text.p: Shares of Manganese Bronze Holdings Plc were marked higher on Friday after upbeat comments from the London taxi producer at its annual general meeting.

Manganese Bronze shares were up 26p at 411-1/2 by 1615 GMT, after chairman Hugh Lang told shareholders taxi production was in line with expectations at 60 vehicles per week, and exceeding the target sometimes.
Lang said the group's components business had won a significant contract from a leading German gearbox maker in addition to orders from Volkswagen AG and General Motors' Opel unit.
